# HeteroServe model manifest. <short_na: # The 4th column is the AUTHORITATIVE sha256, or "-" if nobody has recorded
# one yet. 30_fetch_models.sh verifies against it when present and refuses the
# file on a mismatch. With "-" it can only check the size the server reports,
# which catches truncation but not corruption -- and it says so, rather than
# writing an unverified sum into SHA256SUMS and calling that proof.
# Fill these in once, from a download you trust, and the "all four nodes ran
# the same bytes" claim stops being circular.
# Lines starting with # ignored. Keep the same file on all four nodes so the
# GGUF checksums match across the cluster.
# Q4_K_M is the study's default quantisation; Q8_0 rows are there for the
# quantisation sweep. The Nano's Maxwell GPU is FP16-capable but has no useful
# INT8 path, so K-quant dequant cost lands on the CPU side more than it does on
# the Pi 5 -- that asymmetry is one of the things being characterised.
